cases.title: Repeat promotional spam escalating to a fixed-term suspension

timeline.note: Picking up the four spam reports against this account together - same promotional caption reposted across three listings in one morning.
First warning for repeated promotional posting outside the shop's usual cadence. Advised to space out listing posts and stop reusing identical captions.
Warned the account owner. No removal - content itself doesn't violate policy, frequency did.
Second wave of reports two weeks later, same pattern resumed.
Same account, same pattern as the warning two weeks ago. Escalating internally to a strike.
Third counting warning within the window triggers strike 1 per the discipline ladder.
7-day suspension applied as strike 1's consequence. Account remains suspended as of this report; expiry is in the future.
Account suspended 7 days for repeat spam after an unheeded warning.

cases.outcome: user_suspended remains suspended with an expiry in the future; visible in the admin panel as an active suspension.

cases.title: Personal-dispute report dismissed after review

timeline.note: Reporter's submission text referenced an unrelated old disagreement between the two accounts, not the post's content.
Reviewed the flagged post directly - a routine k8s migration post, nothing resembling harassment. Checking reporter/target history.

Post content does not violate policy. Reporter and target have an unrelated prior disagreement visible in their comment history; this reads as a personal dispute routed through the report system rather than a genuine content violation. No action against the post author.
Dismissed - no policy violation found.

cases.outcome: Report dismissed with a resolution note; no action taken against aaron.codes.

cases.title: Heated argument under a finance post, warning later revoked

reported_content.text: imagine actually believing this, your financial literacy is embarrassing
posts like this just cause panic, this should honestly just get taken down

timeline.note: Reading the thread - the disagreement about property price direction turned personal fast.
Removed - dismissive/insulting tone toward another commenter's financial literacy, not a substantive disagreement.
Removed - dismissive/insulting tone toward another commenter's financial literacy, not a substantive disagreement.
Warned for repeated dismissive comments toward other users in a finance discussion thread.
Comments removed, account owner warned.
Reviewed on appeal - the account has no other history and the thread had provocation on both sides that the original review didn't fully weigh. Revoking the warning; the comment removals stand.

cases.outcome: The two comments stay removed; the warning against toxic.debates was revoked after a later review. Account status is otherwise untouched by this case (suspended separately - see case 1's discipline ladder for a different account).

cases.title: Banned account later reinstated after an administrator review

timeline.note: Reported for sharing an unverified claim about a company layoff that turned out to be a misread of a public announcement, not a fabrication.
Banned for repeated unverified claims presented as fact, following two prior warnings not otherwise recorded in this case's own timeline.

On review, the original claim traced back to a genuine (if garbled) public source rather than fabrication - the ban was disproportionate to what actually happened. Reinstating the account. This does not erase the audit history; it corrects the outcome.

cases.outcome: recovered.user1's current status is active and clean; the audit log still shows the earlier ban_user and the later unban_user rows in order.

cases.title: One moderator session across four content types in a single day

timeline.note: Story flagged by an automated screenshot report from a user; removed pending owner clarification.
Owner clarified this was a gym progress photo, not a policy violation. Restored - story had not yet expired.
Removed a message containing an unsolicited promotional link reported by the recipient.
On second look the link was to the sender's own previously-shared post, not external spam. Restored.
Removed for an unrelated product placement that reads as undisclosed sponsorship under current policy.
Reviewed on the author's request - the item shown was a personal purchase, not sponsored content. Restored to its prior published status.
Removed for an off-topic promotional link left under a design case study.
Comment author clarified the link was to their own portfolio referenced by the post's discussion, not a sales pitch. Restored.

cases.outcome: Same-day sweep across story, message, post, and comment surfaces, with two of the four actions reversed after follow-up review - a realistic mix rather than every takedown being final.
